map.75g口服葡萄糖耐量试验(OGTT)诊断妊娠糖尿病(IADPSG/中国指南): 75 g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) to diagnose gestational diabetes (IADPSG/China guidelines)
map.📖 查看「GDM(OGTT 75g)诊断标准器 使用指南」: 📖 View "GDM (75g OGTT) Diagnosis Standard Tool User Guide"
map.妊娠期糖尿病 OGTT 诊断（75g 糖试验，任一满足即诊断）：空腹血糖 不低于: GDM OGTT (75 g; any one meets diagnosis): fasting >=5.1, 1h >=10.0, 2h >=8.5 mmol/L; fasting >=7.0 or 2h >=11.1 suggests pre-gestational diabetes.
map.检查时机：24–28周；空腹8小时后口服75g葡萄糖，测空腹/服糖后1h/2h静: Timing: 24-28 wks; after 8h fast take 75 g glucose, measure fasting/1h/2h venous glucose
map.注：1项或多项异常即诊断GDM。空腹≥7.0或2h≥11.1应按孕前糖尿病处理。: Note: one or more abnormal = GDM. Fasting >=7.0 or 2h >=11.1 should be treated as pre-gestational diabetes.
map.提示：GDM孕妇产后6–12周应复查75g OGTT以评估糖代谢状态。GDM孕妇: Tip: GDM women should repeat 75 g OGTT at 6-12 weeks postpartum to assess glucose metabolism. Long-term type-2 diabetes risk is increased; long-term follow-up needed. For screening reference only.
map.孕 24–28 周做 75g 葡萄糖耐量试验筛查 GDM。: At 24-28 wks do the 75 g OGTT to screen GDM.
map.任一项超标即诊断，确定营养/胰岛素治疗。: Any one over threshold = diagnosis; decide nutrition/insulin therapy.
map.高危人群提前至孕早期筛查。: High-risk groups screen earlier in the first trimester.
map.空腹 5.8（≥5.1）、1h 10.2（≥10.0）、2h 8.5（≥8.5）: Fasting 5.8 (>=5.1), 1h 10.2 (>=10.0), 2h 8.5 (>=8.5) mmol/L: all three reach the diagnostic cut-offs, so GDM is diagnosed; insulin need is judged against treatment targets (fasting <=5.3, 1h <=7.8, 2h <=6.7).
Fasting 5.1 (>=5.1, abnormal), 1h 8.5 (<10.0), 2h 6.0 (<8.5): one value reaching the cut-off still diagnoses GDM; start medical nutrition therapy, then assess A1/A2 against treatment targets.
map.GDM 诊断标准是什么？: What are the GDM diagnostic criteria?
map.75g OGTT 空腹 ≥5.1、1h ≥10.0、2h ≥8.5 mmol/L: 75 g OGTT: fasting >=5.1, 1h >=10.0, 2h >=8.5 mmol/L; any one value reaching the cut-off diagnoses GDM, no need for all to be elevated. The 5.3/7.8/6.7 values are treatment targets, not diagnostic cut-offs.
map.A1 和 A2 级怎么分？: How are A1 and A2 distinguished?
map.A1 级指饮食运动可控制（空腹达标）；A2 级需加用胰岛素。两者均增加巨大儿与子: A1 = controllable by diet/exercise (fasting meets target); A2 = needs insulin. Both raise macrosomia and preeclampsia risk; postpartum OGTT needed.
map.关于「GDM(OGTT 75g)诊断标准器」: About the "GDM (75g OGTT) Diagnosis Standard Tool"
map.GDM(OGTT 75g)诊断标准器，根据75g口服葡萄糖耐量试验结果诊断妊娠糖: The GDM diagnostic tool diagnoses gestational diabetes from the 75 g OGTT result (IADPSG/IAP standards). A professional medical tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
